source.author: verg
source.text: aut tu, magne pater divom, miserere tuoque invisum hoc detrude caput sub Tartara telo, quando aliter nequeo crudelem abrumpere vitam.
source.text_original: aut tu, magne pater divom, miserere tuoque / invisum hoc detrude caput sub Tartara telo, / quando aliter nequeo crudelem abrumpere vitam.'
source.text_english: Or you, great father of the gods, have mercy and thrust this hateful head of mine down beneath Tartarus with your bolt, since otherwise I cannot tear off this cruel life.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: equidem et ipsa cupio mori, cupio inuisum hoc corpus exuere, sed non quasi adultera.
reuse.text_original: equidem et ipsa cupio mori, cupio inuisum hoc corpus exuere, sed non quasi adultera.
reuse.text_english: Indeed, I too desire to die; I desire to cast off this hateful body, but not as an adulteress.
